passives.name: SkullKnightEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
If the $SkullKnightSelected unit has less damage than this unit:
- Increase this unit's damage by {1}%

If the $SkullKnightSelected unit has more damage than this unit:
- Increase the $SkullKnightSelected unit's range by {2}%
- Increase the $SkullKnightSelected unit's AoE Size by {3}%

If the $SkullKnightSelected unit is Iron Wolf (Struggler) or Silver Falcon:
- Increase the $SkullKnightSelected unit's damage by {1}%
- Increase the $SkullKnightSelected unit's range by {2}%
- Increase the $SkullKnightSelected unit's AoE Size by {3}%
